title: Spectra: The DFT and the FFT

contract.reader: An engineer or student who can call numpy.fft but cannot yet say what a measured spectrum shows or why it looks as it does
contract.problem: Reading amplitudes, frequencies and noise from an FFT correctly, and choosing record length and window
contract.outcome: Compute bin frequencies and resolution, explain leakage and the cost of the FFT, choose and correct for a window, read amplitudes and noise levels
contract.contribution: One derivation-to-practice path (definition, periodicity, FFT, leakage, windows, scaling) with every number reproduced by runnable code and a final recipe table
contract.evidence: Derivations in the text; three scripts with their real output; Cooley and Tukey (1965), Harris (1978), Heideman et al. (1984), Oppenheim and Schafer (2010), Welch (1967)
contract.limitations: Radix-2 only in detail; multitaper and parametric methods out of scope

findings.location: Section 3.2, the display equation after 'the DFT becomes' and the butterfly pair (1280 and 360 px)
findings.problem: Both equations are wider than the text column; O[k] and the index range are hidden behind an unmarked sideways scroll
findings.whyItMatters: These equations are the result of the section; a reader sees an incomplete formula where the argument depends on it
findings.action: Break each equation over lines (aligned block)
findings.acceptance: On new captures both equations are fully visible at 1280 px and no line is cut at 360 px

findings.problem: The last node, butterflies, is off-screen with no scroll cue
findings.whyItMatters: Phone readers miss the node the diagram leads to
findings.action: Site-level scroll cue for wide figures, or a top-to-bottom layout for this diagram
findings.acceptance: At 360 px the butterflies node is visible or a visible cue shows the figure scrolls

findings.problem: The sixth column (Equivalent noise bandwidth) is cut under the scroll shadow
findings.whyItMatters: The ENBW values are used in Section 5.3
findings.acceptance: All six columns visible at 1280 px

findings.problem: Printed lines are longer than the code box; a unit is lost at the edge
findings.whyItMatters: Small; values are repeated in the prose
findings.action: Optional: shorter labels in the print call, then re-run the script
findings.acceptance: Output lines fully visible at 1280 px, or accepted as a limitation
